title: Acme: Rise of the Rockets
tagline: Made for Acme Rockets by PostHog

text.win: Every launch site is yours and every satellite reached orbit. Mission control is cheering.
text.lose: The launch was scrubbed. Check the telemetry, refuel, and plan a new flight.
text.credits: Made for the Acme Rockets crew by PostHog

rival.name: The Scrub Monster
taunts: T-minus never. This launch is scrubbed.
Another pad under my hold. Weather is bad forever.
Tick tock. Your window is closing.
rival.defeat: All systems go. The Scrub Monster drifts off into deep space.
rival.sprite_prompt: a grumpy grey storm cloud monster with lightning eyebrows and a red abort button nose

tips: Take Pad 39A early: launch sites pay out stars every turn.
Feature Flags let you shield your cities. Launch to 1% before 100%.
Harvest near Mission HQ to level it up before the Scrub Monster arrives.
Forests hide your crew. Fight from cover, like a good release plan.

tech_lines.feature_flags: Roll out to 1% of satellites first
tech_lines.error_tracking: Catch it before the customer calls
